title: Mattel
description: Mattel is an American multinational toy and family entertainment company whose portfolio includes Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Matchbox and Monster High. Its corporate identity is built on a single signature red (#e91728, PANTONE 485 C) set against black (#000000) and white (#ffffff), used across the Mattel wordmark and corporate communications.
